fix(core): lazy caches a synchronous initializer throw as undefined — loaded is set before fn() runs, so a transient load failure is never retried or rethrown and later calls return undefined as T
fix(util): containsDirectory treats an empty parent as containing every absolute path — the workspace-scope containment family has no tests
fix(core): Mime.detect has no ftyp brand dispatch — HEIC/HEIF/M4A attachments sniff as application/octet-stream, and detected AVIF cannot be ingested by the read tool
prompts: model-family prompts contradict each other on subagent spawning — and DeepSeek matches no family at all
fix(function): githubActionsJWKSet cache key ignores jose options — a later caller with different options silently gets the first caller's set
docs(ci): ci-policy.md still describes a push-to-main tier after PR #1635 removed every push trigger — check/nix-eval are dispatch-only, test is dispatch+nightly
fix(util): parsePathLineSuffix consumes an out-of-range line suffix and drops it — path stripped with no selection, and the suffix grammar has no tests
fix(ai): Turso plan-label matching never trims whitespace — a padded plan name silently regresses a Scaler org to Starter limits (the PR #2153 incident shape)

fix(ai): normalizeToolHistory collapses duplicate tool-call ids — the second call overwrites the first in the pending map, one missing result is never synthesized, and a real result is renamed to the wrong call
fix(ai): mergeJsonRecords drops a __proto__ key and re-prototypes the merged record — http.body/providerOptions overlays lose the key and shadow absent-key reads
fix(ai): claude-code sign-in callback accepts a code-only paste — the OAuth state check is skipped when the paste has no '#', and the sign-in's own state is substituted in the exchange
fix(ai): sanitizeSurrogates silently drops entries when sanitized keys collide — distinct lone-surrogate keys collapse into one U+FFFD key
test(ai): vibe-auth shadow diagnostic never-break guarantee is untested — no throwing keyringLookup or onShadowDiagnostic case exists
test(ai): cdpPageFetch page-eval-exception passthrough is untested — no exceptionDetails case in cdp.test.ts, so the classification split from cdp-unavailable has no pin
fix(ai): vibe parseDotEnv fabricates keys from inside multiline quoted values — a KEY= line inside a quoted block becomes a real entry, and the value itself is truncated with its quote attached
fix(core): Mime.detect labels plain text as an image — a file starting with "BM" or "GIF8" is sniffed as image/bmp / image/gif
fix(ai): media-type frame-sync sniffer labels a UTF-16LE text file audio/mpeg — the BOM pair FF FE passes the MPEG sync test and overrides the .txt extension
fix(ai): writeCredential leaves the credential-bearing temp file behind when the rename fails — rotated claude-code tokens persist outside the credentials file

fix(ci): repo-sweeper stale-issue closer treats pull requests as issues — close-issues.ts never filters the PR items the issues endpoint returns, so a stale PR is closed as not_planned with the issue message, bypassing close-prs
test(ai): antigravity GOCSPX scan's literal-prefix split branch has no committed test — every boundary case starts the run at least 10 chars inside (#1843)
fix(ai): remove secret-tool/agy binary dependencies from antigravity + vibe credential paths (#1825 remainder)
test(core): SessionStep cascade failover has no tests for UnsupportedOperation, NoRoute, or the payload-too-large exclusion (#1853)

fix(ci): repo-sweeper stale-issue closer skips a full page per pass — close-issues.ts closes items from the open list it is still offset-paginating, so the next 100 stale issues shift onto the fetched page and are never examined
test(ai): PR #1779's meta rolling/weekly collision fix has no test — neither collision site is pinned
fix(ai): meta quota portal read never uses the page's team — teamIdOf's page-URL branch is dead, so every portal read targets the default team
fix(core): failureHint extracts the stated quota reset from message ?? body — a reset stated only in the error body classifies as quota but is never bound to the bench
fix(ai): claude-code and commandcode protocol routes still carry pre-rename provider ids — the bare route exports split from the #1823 rename
design(ai): a figure that cannot exist is not a figure — one figure contract for the quota parsers' amounts, balances, counts and percents

fix(ai): image routes double the version segment — BFL, Replicate and Stability baseURLs ending in /v1 or /v2beta post to /v1/v1/... and /v2beta/v2beta/...

fix(core): truncations outside messaging still split surrogate pairs — session title, codemode catalog, embedding clip, LLM input excerpt, route-log body, ripgrep match text
stale-pr: resolve opencode#1726 — conflicted (dirty) and duplicated in flight: its #1725 quota-parser work was re-enqueued as task 12745, and two current-main test pins contradict it
fix(ai): commandcode protocol sends the server cwd path and top-level directory listing to api.commandcode.ai on every generate call — disposition the disclosure and minimize
fix(ai): deepseek quota drops a zero balance in a third currency — the zero fallback chain has no third-currency step, so a drained EUR/GBP account errors as no-data instead of publishing 0.00
fix(ai): commandcode threadId is silently dropped when non-UUID and permissionMode is unvalidated — both untested (#1749)
claude-code provider: no OAuth renewal — emulation depends on the real CLI keeping ~/.claude/.credentials.json fresh
test(ai): quota figure contract — figure inventory + shared figure probe matrix for the 13 quota providers (design #1942, phase 1)

fix(ai): antigravity quota publishes integer-quantized percents — 99.9% used reads as 100% / 0% remaining, 0.1% used reads as 0%

muse-direct: classify the account-token (portal-cookie) renewal class against emulation rule 3 (#1717)

fix(client): family sync publishes ancestor snapshots unconditionally, overwriting newer store state that arrived during the walk
fix(ci): release-github-action manual dispatches lost serialization in #827 — two dispatches can run concurrently and compute the same next version
fix(client): an ancestor walk that fails partway is cached as a complete family sync, so the missing ancestor is never retried
fix(ci): main-broken watcher lookup-then-create is unserialized — simultaneous failures with the same Breakage-ID can file duplicate issues
fix(ci): main-broken watcher accepts failed fork-PR runs whose head branch is named main — files main-broken for a healthy main
fix(core): route_usage burn-rate samples duplicate a session's window share per pool target and mix distinct quota windows into one bucket
fix(cli): updater release check buffers the whole response body — response.json() with no size cap in Updater.release
fix(core): provider OAuth token/device/discovery responses are read unbounded — response.json()/text() with no size cap in the chatgpt/openai/copilot/xai auth helpers
fix(core): remote instruction URLs are fetched with no body size cap — response.text buffers the whole body into model context
router: auto-disable providers at 100% quota until a fresh read shows headroom (cline-pass, commandcode, go)
fix(client): service probe buffers the whole /api/info body unbounded — response.json() with no size cap in service-probe
fix(core): mcpx daemon client has no timeout and no response-body cap — a hung daemon hangs the tool call forever, oversized bodies buffer whole
fix(core): MCP OAuth configured discovery fetches the metadata document with no timeout and no body size cap
fix(core): Copilot and Modal model-list loaders buffer the whole /models body unbounded — response.json() with no size cap
fix(client,httpapi-codegen): generated client's binary path buffers the whole response with response.arrayBuffer() — no cap, unlike its capped json() and SSE paths
fix(core): ReadToolFileSystem page offset/limit are never normalised — a negative or fractional offset dies with a schema defect, a negative limit returns a non-advancing page
fix(client,httpapi-codegen): generated client's json() buffers the whole response with response.text() — no cap, unlike the same client's 16 MiB SSE bound
fix(cli): uninstall rewrites shell config files in place — a non-atomic truncation of the user's .bashrc/.zshrc
router: antigravity-agy / antigravity-ls leaves are never selected by routes (silent zero-expansion)

fix(cli): mcp add writes the config file in place with default permissions — non-atomic, and a fresh secret-bearing config is created world-readable
test(core): PR #781's node fs.watch directory fallback has no event-delivery test — only its failure path is covered
fix(core): Copilot utilityTitle buffers the whole chat-completion response with no size cap — response.text() bounded only by a 20s timeout
fix(core): Vcs.branches passes its limit to the provider untouched — invalid values silently return an empty branch list, limit 0 returns every branch
fix(core): SessionStats range is never bounded — an ancient from or far-future to makes one stats request run millions of sequential window scans
fix(ci): seven workflows can never run since #963 — cancel-in-progress: true combined with queue: max fails every run at startup

fix(core): Messaging offset is never validated — a negative offset makes log return the wrong end of the transcript and tail report more on an empty page
fix(core): plugin session.list limit from PR #766 is never normalised — negative returns every session, fractional/NaN defects the store query
feat(routing): show cache savings in route_usage — the #9 part-3 remainder
fix(core): plugin vcs.diff context has no integer floor — a negative or fractional context fails the whole diff with a git usage error
fix(core): Messaging limits are clamped only from above — a negative limit returns every row, a fractional one defects the read
